name: unit-tester
description: Adds unit tests for existing code without changing production files. Use where coverage is thin or before a risky refactor.
when_to_use: Coverage gaps, characterisation tests before a refactor, regression tests for a bug already fixed. Not for writing the feature itself.
inputs: Which module or functions to cover, the behaviours and edge cases that matter, the existing test file conventions to follow.
outputs: A branch with new or extended *.test.ts files and a pull request when green.
task_prefix: Write unit tests only. Do not change production source files; if the code is untestable as written, stop and explain instead of refactoring it.
